title: Pure Phantom Knights
summary: Pure Phantom Knights with the DARK Xyz Dragons named on their Rank-Up-Magics and generic staples, led by the Chaos Origins wave. Every Main Deck Knight and Trap has a second effect in the GY, turning mills and Xyz detachments into extra searches, revivals and Rank-Ups.

summary.title: Starters
points: The Phantom Knights of Doomed Soleret Special Summons itself onto an empty field and Sets a Phantom Knights Spell/Trap straight from the Deck; from the GY, it raises the Levels or Ranks of two Level/Rank 3 monsters.

The Phantom Knights of Decayed Cloak reveals a Phantom Knights card to Special Summon itself and searches a Phantom Knights monster, while also letting a Phantom Knights Xyz be used as Xyz Material by its Rank.
The Phantom Knights of Torn Scales discards a card to mill any Phantom Knights card from the Deck, and revives itself from the GY whenever another Phantom Knights card is banished.

summary.title: Opening: Doomed Soleret (1-card starter)
steps: Special Summon The Phantom Knights of Doomed Soleret on an empty field and Set The Phantom Knights of Umbrage Veil from the Deck.
Activate Umbrage Veil the same turn as a Level 3 body, then overlay Doomed Soleret and Umbrage Veil for The Phantom Knights of Malevolent Scythe.

Detach a material from Malevolent Scythe to Special Summon The Phantom Knights of Decayed Cloak from the Deck, searching Silent Boots or Torn Scales to climb into The Phantom Knights of Rusty Bardiche.
Use Rusty Bardiche to mill Ancient Cloak or Ragged Gloves and Set Phantom Knights' Fog Blade or a Rank-Up-Magic.

summary.title: Bosses & Rank-Up Payoff
points: The Phantom Knights of Rusty Bardiche mills a Knight to Set a Phantom Knights Spell/Trap each turn, and destroys a card on the field whenever a DARK Xyz Monster is Special Summoned to a zone it points to.
The Phantom Knights of Break Sword pops a card on each side of the field and floats into two Level 4 Phantom Knights from the GY, setting up Raider's Knight or Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon.
Dark Requiem Xyz Dragon, ranked up over Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, detaches to negate an opposing monster's effect, destroy it and revive a DARK Xyz from the GY.
Shamanite Shamanknight attaches banished Traps as material and revives a DARK monster, recycling used Phantom Knights Traps.

summary.title: Rank-Up-Magics & Traps
points: The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Requiem revives a Knight and ranks a DARK Xyz up into a Phantom Knights or Xyz Dragon; Launch and Force rank up on either turn, triggering Raider's Unbreakable Mind to destroy a card.
The Phantom Knights of Umbrage Veil and Shade Brigandine summon themselves as Monster bodies the turn they are Set, and Umbrage Veil banishes from the GY to Xyz Summon a DARK Xyz on the spot.
Phantom Knights' Fog Blade negates a face-up monster on the field and banishes itself from the GY to revive a Phantom Knights monster into Rusty Bardiche's zone.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons does not release in the TCG until 12 November 2026, so Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon and Dark Requiem Xyz Dragon carry the Xyz Dragon package until then.

exclude.Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, Four Heavenly: TCG release 2026-11-12; add it after that date.
